notes.title: Demo Patch 2.2 Update!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121563/19294b00aee124d6dfc05f3af274b93bf6d8ca6a.png"]

Update 2.2 brings a few more additions from batch 2, which will be finished fully in the next few months.

The focus of this update is to bring players into action quicker and emphasizes PVP oriented changes including changes to spawn locations and geometry of the map to create more "choke zones".



The update also brings 3 brand new mythics with completely new mechanics never seen before in the game, we hope you like them!



TOFBuild_Demo_2.2

Improved AI behaviour.

Added "Thunderlock" mythic with effect "Cannons stun the enemy for 1 segment (their next segment). Lose 30% of your damage on pickup".

Added "Hellfire Barrage" mythic with effect "Cannons now deal 3 block AOE damage. Lose 30% of your damage on pickup.".

Added "One-Eyed Beast" mythic with effect "Double your base damage. Set your max ammo to 1".

 Temporarly disabled Sentinel mythic.

 Changed all spawn positions to be more PVP oriented.

Update geometry of Emerald Isles to be more PVP oriented.



Upcoming updates

 Add 2 mythic cards rounds allowing combination of mythics.

Improved tutorial.

Add 2 new world events.

Mac support

notes.title: Demo Patch 2.1 Update!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121563/30968bcfd6be5cb99577f617325a6cd6a2ae310c.png"]

Today we bring you patch 2.1. This update brings a new visual rework to the ship controller giving the ability to assign cannons through the grid (similar to assigning moves), players can still assign cannons through the board like before if they wish. 



This feature is only 1 of many coming in our Batch 2 update coming soon, but we just could not wait to release this one early as it enhances the player experiences a lot! Let us know how it feels and please give us feedback! 



TOFBuild_Demo_2.1 

Fixed bug crashing users trying to start session through custom lobbies.

Updated big parts of the framework to support upcoming features for "Batch 2" update.

Added assigning cannons through the grid (similar to assigning moves), players can still assign cannons through the board like before if they wish.

Added cannon placing sound effect.

notes.title: Batch 1 Update Live Now!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121563/27a24ee57b7bea6ef86d592d00dc8c4deb8a18da.png"]

Today we bring to you the first out of a 2 part update to improve and make our demo even more enjoyable to play!

Batch 1 of the update brings a few major changes to the game based on feedback from the initial release as well as a bunch of bug fixes.

1v1 map named "Twilight Shores".

Gain "Fleet Status" levels.

Turbo mode 1v1 (30 second rounds).

Wind direction change less often.

Adding portals to help move across the map faster.

Reduce healing on kill.

Increase curse zone speed.

Increase player base damage.

Fixed Collision bug resulting in players stacking on top of each others.

Batch 2 coming out later will focus on events, ai improvements, unlocks and more perks.

Play our demo now! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: August Update: P2P and Custom Lobbies!
notes.content:
Up until this point we've been using dedicated servers to run Tales of Fortune. Dedicated servers are expensive to manage especially early in development therefore we have opted to creating a new solution which will both save us money and allow for a more flexible system. This means that now all servers will be running through peer-to-peer, one player will be hosting the server on their local PC and the other players will be connecting to that user through Steam. 

Making this change has been a hurdle to overcome because as mentioned earlier the game has always been running using a dedicated server architecture which means that quite late in development we've had to change to a new system. So we are happy to announce that peer-to-peer is now functioning and running. We will be using the upcoming week to test and ensure that it works properly.  

We are still hoping to be able to use dedicated servers for all competitive games, therefore dedicated servers will be a system that we will keep exploring in the future but for now the upcoming demo will be exclusively running using peer-to-peer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121563/36b3e108c13dcc24fa9fe4ccb4d03320a68fce0d.png

We've also been working on making an enhanced lobby system allowing players to connect to each other using the Steam API. This means that the players wont have to worry about port forwarding to connect to each other. The new lobby system features the ability to create custom games that other players can join through our lobby hosting system. 

Next we will be working on creating an automatic matchmaking system where players can connect to other players without having to worry about creating any lobbies. This will also be the backbone system for any upcoming competitive game modes in the future.

- Hadi

notes.title: July Update: Collision and Grid Indicators!
notes.content:
In this update, we’ve enhanced ship collision interactions with new animations, adding 10 unique collision scenarios, including ship-to-ship and environmental collisions. These improvements are designed to handle various situations, providing a more immersive experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121563/434ac6825866867168fdcb421adae3da183c307f.png

Additionally, we’ve updated the movement visuals with new grid indicators. These indicators show the tiles where players can move and display the move costs, making the gameplay more intuitive, especially for new players. The new indicators also distinguish collidable tiles. While you’ll never be restricted from making a move (even if it results in a collision), this update makes it clearer which tiles are collidable, especially in situations where it might not be immediately obvious.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121563/248bc6f7253b815d3b2ce1b3e19768424d435e59.png
- Hadi
